description: This file is a server-side route handler for a Cases List page in a SvelteKit application. It includes logic for loading case data via API requests, transforming data for frontend use, and handling various actions such as creating, updating, closing, re-opening, deleting, commenting, and moving cases.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads case data from the API, applies filters, transforms API data into frontend-friendly structure, and returns data for rendering the Cases List page.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new case by collecting form data and making an API POST request.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing case with new data.

methods.name: actions.close
methods.description: Closes a case by updating its status to 'Closed'.

methods.name: actions.reopen
methods.description: Reopens a case by changing its status to 'Assigned'.

methods.name: actions.comment
methods.description: Adds a comment to a case.

methods.name: actions.moveCase
methods.description: Handles moving cases within a Kanban or list view, updating the case position or status.
